endomorphism.frobenius_order_rule: Z[pi], pi = tau^n, has discriminant t^2 - 4q = -7 f^2
endomorphism.proof: tau(x, y) = (x^2, y^2) is an F_2-rational endomorphism with tau^2 - mu tau + 2 = 0; Z[tau] has discriminant mu^2 - 8 = -7, a fundamental discriminant, so Z[tau] is the maximal order of Q(sqrt(-7)), and End(E/F_2^n) is an order of that field containing it

volcano_levels.odd_ell: L0 (surface) for every odd prime ell: v_ell(1) = 0

field.element_encoding: unsigned integer; bit i is the coefficient of z^i

point_decomposition.cache_policy: V^(2) parity checks, HT, V-syndrome, pi and column byte tables per factor base
point_decomposition.online_implementation: htfast.c htf_run: W = 32 walks per round; one Montgomery inversion (four interleaved chains) for the walk denominators and one for every 1/S; columns pi(S HT(v_j^2)), pi(S) read from byte tables linear in S; one reduced-echelon elimination over l + 1 unknowns (eps included); the candidates of a round share one batched inversion of u^2; signed lifts checked in C
point_decomposition.solver: half-trace projection onto F / V^(2) plus the trace row, residual enumeration over the solution space, X = u HT(p/u^2) kept if X in V and the signed lifts sum to R
point_decomposition.summation_polynomial: S_3 as the Artin-Schreier equation (p/S)^2 + p/S = (u + sqrt(b)/S)^2, u = X + Y, p = XY (Courtois, ePrint 2016/003)

relation_collection.query_law: W = 256 walks R_i = [k0]G + i [a]G (workload collection stream)
relation_collection.rows: every verified decomposition of every walk point, a row over the folded columns with right-hand side k0 + i a mod r
relation_collection.verification: C: signed lifts of X and Y sum to R exactly

relation_linear_algebra.rank_criterion: none: unfixed components stay symbolic and a target row is used only if its t coefficients cancel
relation_linear_algebra.solver: gain graph: BFS writes each column as alpha t + beta in its component root t; a row with nonzero t coefficient fixes t; every row is checked; every fixed log is verified [x]G = rep

target_descent.policy: Q + i [a0]G, i = 1, 2, ... (v1: 32 walks advancing by 32 [a0]G; v0, py: one walk), decomposed by the online oracle until a row evaluates on the logs; log Q = value - i a0 mod r
target_descent.success: [log Q]G = Q, inside the online interval
